body:
Port Claude Code's Stop-hook review() advisory to Codex, using the canonical `@adlc/core` risk-tier module and following plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-stop.mjs's cleaner `stopAudit` shape as the primary implementation reference — NOT Claude Code's ~700-line inline version, which duplicates logic Cursor already factored well.

=== CORRECTED UNDERSTANDING (verified before writing this revision) ===
packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs is the canonical, published source of matchRiskTier/classifyRiskTier/decideAdversarialReviewNotice/RISK_TIER_PATTERNS (re-exported at the @adlc/core package root). Claude Code's adlc-hook.mjs inline-copies these with an explicit 'KEEP IN SYNC with packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs' comment (line 438) -- confirming this is a copy, not original logic, for the same hook-runtime-can't-resolve-npm-packages reason as T49's build-gate copy.

plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-stop.mjs already implements the exact same feature for Cursor, and does it more cleanly: a single `stopAudit(root, opts)` function covers BOTH the gate-manifest verify check AND the risk-gated adversarial-review notice (Claude Code splits these into two separate Stop-hook invocations, `manifest` and `review`). Cursor's plugin CAN apparently resolve @adlc/core via real npm imports at hook runtime (its adlc-stop.mjs does `import { classifyRiskTier, decideAdversarialReviewNotice, ticketStoreExists } from '@adlc/core'` directly) -- this is NOT available to Codex (confirmed for T49: Codex's plugin installs via git marketplace, not npm install, so its installed hook location has no node_modules; docs/integrations/codex.md: 'installing @adlc/codex with npm alone does not register the plugin with Codex'). So Codex's port must inline-copy from packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs (KEEP IN SYNC, drift-tested), but should follow CURSOR's cleaner stopAudit SHAPE and its more robust gitChangedPaths (git status --porcelain -z, NUL-delimited, no manual quote-unescaping needed -- strictly more robust than Claude Code's quote-parsing unquoteGitStatusPath) rather than Claude Code's more sprawling implementation.

=== CONTRACT (write then gate) ===
Author .adlc/specs/codex-review-nudge.md before coding (replaces the prior draft, which assumed Claude Code's version was the only/best reference). Must pin: the inline-copy boundary (matchRiskTier/classifyRiskTier/decideAdversarialReviewNotice/RISK_TIER_PATTERNS, KEEP IN SYNC with packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs, drift-tested), the gitChangedPaths implementation (port Cursor's -z NUL-delimited git status/ls-files/diff approach, not Claude Code's), active-ticket resolution (reuse adlc-build-gate.mjs's/adlc-rails-guard.mjs's resolveActiveTicketId, degrading a conflict to null for this advisory context rather than failing closed -- exactly Cursor's `active.conflict ? null : active.id` pattern), and where the unified check lands in Codex's Stop hook (extend adlc-lifecycle.mjs's existing `verify` mode into a combined verify+review check, OR add a new `review` mode invoked alongside `verify` in hooks.json's Stop entry -- the spec decides based on which keeps adlc-lifecycle.mjs's per-mode structure cleanest).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. A `review` capability in plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs (new mode, or folded into `verify` per the spec's decision), porting: an inline KEEP-IN-SYNC copy of matchRiskTier/classifyRiskTier/decideAdversarialReviewNotice from packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs, a gitChangedPaths implementation following Cursor's -z NUL-delimited approach, and reuse of the existing active-ticket resolution (degraded to null on conflict).
2. hooks.json wiring: add the review invocation to the Stop entry alongside (or merged with) the existing verify command.
3. Drift test: import both the new inline copy's exported functions and packages/core's real risk-tier.mjs exports, assert identical output across shared fixtures (mirrors T49's drift-test pattern and packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs's precedent). Plus coverage: notice fires on unscoped/risk-gated changes with no manifest record, notice suppressed when a satisfying record exists, gitChangedPaths correctly handles quoted/renamed paths via the -z form, ticket-conflict degrades to null rather than failing the whole Stop hook.
4. Docs: plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md and adlc-prosecute/SKILL.md updated to mention the automatic Stop-time nudge.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: A session that touched risk-gated files with no corresponding gate-manifest adversarial-review record receives a systemMessage nudge at Stop. VERIFY: new/extended hooks test.
- AC2: The notice is suppressed when the manifest already shows a satisfying adversarial-review record for the active ticket. VERIFY: same test file.
- AC3: The inline copy's matchRiskTier/classifyRiskTier/decideAdversarialReviewNotice produce IDENTICAL output to packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs's real exports across the shared fixture set (the drift test). VERIFY: same test file.
- AC4: The existing `verify` Stop behavior (gate-manifest verify) is unchanged and both checks run at Stop (either as one combined message or two coexisting hook entries, per the spec's decision). VERIFY: hooks test.
- AC5: `adlc rails-guard --base main --ticket T50` passes; `npm test` passes at the root.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Making the notice a hard gate (stays advisory, matching every existing harness's Stop-hook philosophy).
- Changing packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs or plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks/adlc-stop.mjs (source references; port from them, do not modify).
- T48/T49/T51/T52/T53.
title: Port the Stop-time adversarial-review nudge to Codex (packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs)
